[package]
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.88.0"
name = "time"
version = "0.3.47"
authors = [
    "Jacob Pratt <open-source@jhpratt.dev>",
    "Time contributors",
]
build = false
include = [
    "{src,tests,benchmarks}/**/*",
    "LICENSE-*",
    "README.md",
]
autolib = false
autobins = false
autoexamples = false
autotests = false
autobenches = false
description = "Date and time library. Fully interoperable with the standard library. Mostly compatible with #![no_std]."
homepage = "https://time-rs.github.io"
readme = "README.md"
keywords = [
    "date",
    "time",
    "calendar",
    "duration",
]
categories = [
    "date-and-time",
    "no-std",
    "parser-implementations",
    "value-formatting",
]
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
repository = "https://github.com/time-rs/time"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
all-features = true
targets = ["x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"]
rustdoc-args = ["--generate-link-to-definition"]

[features]
alloc = ["serde_core?/alloc"]
default = ["std"]
formatting = [
    "dep:itoa",
    "std",
    "time-macros?/formatting",
]
large-dates = [
    "time-core/large-dates",
    "time-macros?/large-dates",
]
local-offset = [
    "std",
    "dep:libc",
    "dep:num_threads",
]
macros = ["dep:time-macros"]
parsing = ["time-macros?/parsing"]
quickcheck = [
    "dep:quickcheck",
    "alloc",
    "deranged/quickcheck",
]
rand = [
    "rand08",
    "rand09",
]
rand08 = [
    "dep:rand08",
    "deranged/rand08",
]
rand09 = [
    "dep:rand09",
    "deranged/rand09",
]
serde = [
    "dep:serde_core",
    "time-macros?/serde",
    "deranged/serde",
]
serde-human-readable = [
    "serde",
    "formatting",
    "parsing",
]
serde-well-known = [
    "serde",
    "formatting",
    "parsing",
]
std = ["alloc"]
wasm-bindgen = ["dep:js-sys"]

[lib]
name = "time"
path = "src/lib.rs"
bench = false

[[test]]
name = "tests"
path = "tests/integration/main.rs"

[[bench]]
name = "benchmarks"
path = "benchmarks/main.rs"
harness = false

[dependencies.deranged]
version = "0.5.2"
features = ["powerfmt"]

[dependencies.itoa]
version = "1.0.1"
optional = true

[dependencies.num-conv]
version = "0.2.0"

[dependencies.powerfmt]
version = "0.2.0"
default-features = false

[dependencies.quickcheck]
version = "1.0.3"
optional = true
default-features = false

[dependencies.rand08]
version = "0.8.4"
optional = true
default-features = false
package = "rand"

[dependencies.rand09]
version = "0.9.2"
optional = true
default-features = false
package = "rand"

[dependencies.serde_core]
version = "1.0.220"
optional = true
default-features = false

[dependencies.time-core]
version = "=0.1.8"

[dependencies.time-macros]
version = "=0.2.27"
optional = true

[dev-dependencies.num-conv]
version = "0.2.0"

[dev-dependencies.quickcheck_macros]
version = "1.0.0"

[dev-dependencies.rand08]
version = "0.8.4"
default-features = false
package = "rand"

[dev-dependencies.rand09]
version = "0.9.2"
features = ["small_rng"]
default-features = false
package = "rand"

[dev-dependencies.rstest]
version = "0.26.1"
default-features = false

[dev-dependencies.rstest_reuse]
version = "0.7.0"

[dev-dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0.184"

default-features = false

[dev-dependencies.serde_json]
version = "1.0.68"

[dev-dependencies.serde_test]
version = "1.0.126"

[dev-dependencies.time-macros]
version = "=0.2.27"

[target."cfg(__ui_tests)".dev-dependencies.trybuild]
version = "1.0.102"

[target.'cfg(all(target_family = "wasm", not(any(target_os = "emscripten", target_os = "wasi"))))'.dependencies.js-sys]
version = "0.3.58"
optional = true

[target."cfg(bench)".dev-dependencies.criterion]
version = "0.8.1"
default-features = false

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct DifferentVariant;

build_selection.inactive_control: Without parsing, TryFromParsed module and selected conversion functions are inactive; preserve outcome distinction.

bounded_contract.normal: Supplied static name reference and conditional flag preserved exactly through constructors, From wrapping and inverse Ok payload; InsufficientInformation returns nominal DifferentVariant.
bounded_contract.effects: No content read, allocation, writes, panic or divergence in selected bodies. String backing identity and length preserved.
bounded_contract.authority: Exact core From/TryFrom impl, associated Error, complete Copy evidence and source ownership; full mixed enum alternatives and guarded payload origins.

independent_expectations: unconditional(name) returns exact supplied static name pointer/length/bytes and false
conditional(name) returns exact supplied static name pointer/length/bytes and true
From retains both fields under ComponentRange tag
inverse ComponentRange branch returns Ok with exact same backing/length/content/flag
inverse InsufficientInformation branch returns nominal DifferentVariant
same content with distinct static backing must retain selected backing
negative_expectations: omitted/swapped variant, wrong payload slot/tag, wrong owner or associated Error rejects
missing/forged Copy evidence or hidden Drop/generated impl rejects
erased Shared type cannot alone prove static source obligation
repeated scrutinee, unguarded payload or arm binding escape rejects
DifferentVariant is never replaced by unit or a tuple-unit struct
altered source/import/cfg/trait identity and historical profile activation reject

oracle_scope.public: Unchanged original time library produces real ComponentRange errors through Month and Date APIs; invoke original public From/TryFrom chain and assert exact reference/flag/tag behavior. Additional producer bodies are runtime inputs, not selected extraction targets.
oracle_scope.private: Exact selected declarations/conversion impls and private constructor source copied into diagnostic module for arbitrary static names, including empty/Unicode/distinct backing. Neighbors remain frozen context but are not compiled in this witness; no original-library constructor admission/execution claim.
oracle_scope.not_proved: Runtime oracle does not prove source authority, strict extraction/admission/matching, cleanup effects or unsupported contexts.
